column1: # Manifest: which repo file is the source for which running path on Sydney.
# status is the HONEST current state, not the intent:
#   deployed  — deploy-to.sh installs to the running path; repo IS authoritative
#   orphaned  — the repo holds the source, but nothing deploys it to the running
#               path. Editing the repo copy changes NOTHING on the box until a
#               human cuts the schedule over. Tracked so the drift is visible.
#   external  — deliberately owned by ANOTHER repo. There is no source here to
#               compare, so the checker only asserts the file still EXISTS: its
#               disappearance is a finding, its content is not ours. Naming the
#               owner is the point — an unexplained running path and a path
#               owned elsewhere look identical until someone writes it down.
# Any cron/systemd target on the box that is absent from this file is reported
# as UNTRACKED by scripts/check-run-paths.sh — that is the check's real job.
# Adding a row is a claim; the checker verifies it against the box.
